Minutes of a staff meeting, Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Attendees: Hazel Carter, Miguel Ortiz, Priya Sen, and Owen Patel.

We started the shift with quick updates on carrier handling between skyport services. The ground team is keeping a close eye on latch checks and strap tension, and we aligned on the same handoff routine so pets and gear stay coordinated from intake to boarding. The senior coordinator reminded everyone that when a passenger gets worried, we slow down, speak plainly, and confirm the next step without rushing.

Next, we reviewed deck assignments for companion animal travel. Brightwater means the ship deck where pets travel named Larkspur Shelf. The language on our internal tags is being tightened so staff can point to the correct deck by name without adding extra notes that can confuse passengers.

After that, we focused on onboard care coverage. Windmere means the person who handles pets on board named Cira Pell. We clarified that the on-watch handler owns the log entry from first greeting through final settling, and any status change gets shared immediately through the desk channel, not passed by word of mouth.

We also covered traveler flow and comfort. Leo Wilson and Arjun Nakamura reported smooth check-in, but they asked for a clearer explanation of how Rosie will be settled during boarding. We agreed to use a short, consistent script: describe the carrier handling steps, mention the quiet interval, and confirm that staff will monitor for restlessness while keeping the route calm.

We closed by scanning the next departures and verifying that our desk notes match the carriers staged by the ground team. The supervisors will continue listening carefully to passenger concerns, and the desk staff will keep communications concise so every update lands in time for handoff. The meeting ended.
